sessions.phase_label: LinkedIn, Apollo, and HubSpot data-flow design
MeetAlfred, campaign-domain, and email infrastructure setup
Cross-platform integration, testing, and campaign launch

requirements.title: Sales Navigator Lead List Setup
requirements.definition: Set up lead lists in LinkedIn Sales Navigator for use as the initial source of campaign contacts.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers list preparation in Sales Navigator only; exporting, enrichment, CRM synchronization, and campaign import are separate behaviors.

requirements.title: CRM Membership Visibility on LinkedIn
requirements.definition: Allow a user reviewing a LinkedIn profile to determine whether that person is already represented in the lead system before adding them again.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the duplicate-visibility behavior, not the broader lead-export pipeline or the CRM's own duplicate alert.

requirements.title: LinkedIn Profile URL Capture
requirements.definition: Store normal LinkedIn profile URLs, rather than only Sales Navigator URLs, with exported CRM contacts.
requirements.boundary_note: The expected URL representation can be modified independently of export, enrichment, and duplicate detection.

requirements.title: LinkedIn-to-Apollo Lead Export
requirements.definition: Export selected LinkedIn or Sales Navigator contacts into Apollo with a small number of user actions.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the source-to-Apollo transfer only; Apollo enrichment and Apollo-to-HubSpot synchronization have separate outputs and execution trajectories.

requirements.title: Apollo Contact Enrichment
requirements.definition: Use Apollo to enrich lead records, including discovering email addresses where available.
requirements.boundary_note: Email discovery is the enrichment mechanism; importing records that remain without email is a separate fallback behavior.

requirements.title: Apollo-to-HubSpot Contact Synchronization
requirements.definition: Transfer Apollo contacts and enriched contact data into HubSpot through an automated integration.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement ends at successful HubSpot delivery; LinkedIn-to-Apollo export and HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred transfer remain separate.

requirements.title: Import Contacts Without Email Addresses
requirements.definition: Permit contacts for which Apollo cannot find an email address to still be transferred into HubSpot using a fallback export-and-upload path.
requirements.boundary_note: This fallback has its own acceptance criterion and can succeed or fail independently of email enrichment.

requirements.title: Direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot CRM Synchronization
requirements.definition: Provide a direct Sales Navigator and HubSpot CRM synchronization path when an appropriate LinkedIn plan is available.
requirements.boundary_note: This direct integration can be deferred or dropped while the accepted Apollo-mediated flow continues, so it is not merged with that alternate flow.

requirements.title: HubSpot Lead Management Model
requirements.definition: Configure HubSpot properties, tags, lead stages, categories, lists, notes, tasks, and nurturing structures used to manage leads.
requirements.boundary_note: The listed properties and stages are attributes of one CRM management mechanism; reporting and cross-platform status updates remain independent.

requirements.title: Lead Communication History in HubSpot
requirements.definition: Make email and LinkedIn conversation history for leads visible inside HubSpot.
requirements.boundary_note: Conversation history is independently useful and testable; it is not equivalent to the lead-status field updated by replies.

requirements.title: HubSpot Sales Funnel Reporting
requirements.definition: Provide HubSpot reporting that presents contacts by Contact Source, stage counts for each source, and conversion from contacts to leads.
requirements.boundary_note: Contact Source, stage breakdown, and contact-to-lead conversion are coupled dimensions of the requested funnel rather than separate reports.

requirements.title: Silent-Lead Follow-Up Automation
requirements.definition: Move non-responsive leads from prior CRM lists into follow-up lists and campaigns without manually cleaning the earlier MeetAlfred campaigns.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a lead-recycling workflow, distinct from the basic transfer of newly added HubSpot contacts into a MeetAlfred campaign.

requirements.title: HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred Lead Transfer
requirements.definition: Automatically push qualifying contacts added to a HubSpot list into a selected MeetAlfred campaign through Zapier.
requirements.boundary_note: Lead transfer has its own failure and recovery trajectory; campaign creation and MeetAlfred-to-HubSpot status synchronization are separate mechanisms.

requirements.title: MeetAlfred Campaign Creation Workflow
requirements.definition: Allow the user to create a new MeetAlfred campaign and connect it to a corresponding HubSpot list by configuring or duplicating a Zap.
requirements.boundary_note: This covers establishing a new campaign and its Zap mapping, not whether contacts subsequently transfer through that mapping.

requirements.title: MeetAlfred Activity Status Synchronization
requirements.definition: Update HubSpot lead status from MeetAlfred or LinkedIn activity, including replies and accepted connection requests.
requirements.boundary_note: Reply and connection outcomes are event mappings within one status-synchronization mechanism rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Automated LinkedIn Campaign
requirements.definition: Configure an automated LinkedIn outreach campaign in MeetAlfred.
requirements.boundary_note: LinkedIn outreach can be enabled, modified, or tested independently of the email campaign channel.

requirements.title: Automated Email Campaign
requirements.definition: Configure an automated email outreach campaign in MeetAlfred.
requirements.boundary_note: Email campaign execution is independent of LinkedIn campaign execution and of the one-time email-account integration task.

requirements.title: Campaign Email Integration
requirements.definition: Connect the campaign email account with MeetAlfred and HubSpot so it can participate in outreach and CRM workflows.
requirements.boundary_note: This is cross-platform email connectivity; provisioning the mailbox and warming the domain are separate infrastructure tasks.

requirements.title: Campaign Domain Provisioning
requirements.definition: Acquire and configure a separate domain for outbound email campaigns, ultimately identified as argentics-games.io.
requirements.boundary_note: Domain acquisition is a one-time deliverable; mailbox creation, forwarding, and reputation warm-up can evolve independently.

requirements.title: Campaign Email Account
requirements.definition: Create an operational email account on the campaign domain for outbound use.
requirements.boundary_note: The mailbox is the persistent campaign identity; its provider choice and setup details are attributes rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Campaign Domain and Email Warm-Up
requirements.definition: Warm the new campaign domain and mailbox before regular outbound email use, using a dedicated warm-up service when available.
requirements.boundary_note: Warm-up duration, service, seat count, and subscription duration are attributes of one bounded deliverability task.

requirements.title: Campaign Domain Web Forwarding
requirements.definition: Forward web visits for the campaign domain to the company's main website.
requirements.boundary_note: Web forwarding is independently testable and unrelated to email warm-up or mailbox integration.

requirements.title: Google Workspace Setup Guide
requirements.definition: Provide a reusable guide for setting up the campaign-domain email through Google Workspace.
requirements.boundary_note: The requested guide is a standalone delivery artifact rather than an implementation status message for the mailbox itself.

requirements.title: HubSpot Starter Plan Constraint
requirements.definition: Use HubSpot Starter Customer Platform on a monthly subscription while it remains sufficient for the required CRM functions.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a client-relevant technology and cost constraint, not a broad substitute for the individual HubSpot behaviors.

requirements.title: MeetAlfred Pro Plan Constraint
requirements.definition: Use the MeetAlfred Pro plan needed for the required integrations.
requirements.boundary_note: The plan selection is an implementation constraint that can change independently of campaign and lead-transfer behavior.

requirements.title: Zapier Pro Plan Constraint
requirements.definition: Use Zapier Pro without add-ons to support the required cross-platform integrations.
requirements.boundary_note: This captures the confirmed subscription configuration, not the individual Zaps or their runtime outcomes.

requirements.title: Preserve Existing MeetAlfred Campaigns
requirements.definition: Do not delete or disrupt existing MeetAlfred campaigns while configuring and testing the new integrations.
requirements.boundary_note: Campaign preservation and test-data isolation protect different production assets and can fail independently.

requirements.title: Use Non-Production Leads for Integration Tests
requirements.definition: Use mock, private, or otherwise non-production leads for integration testing and avoid using genuine HubSpot or MeetAlfred leads.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a concrete data-safety constraint on testing, not a generic QA or debugging Requirement.

requirements.title: Integration Walkthrough
requirements.definition: Guide the client through how the completed Apollo, HubSpot, MeetAlfred, and Zapier integrations operate.
requirements.boundary_note: The walkthrough is a standalone handover obligation, not evidence that any specific integration is runtime-verified.

requirements.title: Multichannel Outbound Campaign Scripts
requirements.definition: Prepare outbound campaign message scripts and timing sequences for a multichannel campaign.
requirements.boundary_note: Script content and timing are a separate prospective deliverable from campaign execution and CRM lead tracking.

requirements.title: Outbound Campaign Execution Mode
requirements.definition: Run outbound outreach through MeetAlfred automation unless a sufficiently strong alternative is agreed, while resolving whether manual conversations are needed for appointment generation.
requirements.boundary_note: This captures the unresolved automation-versus-manual execution decision, not the scripts, account identities, or CRM import mechanism.

requirements.title: CRM Tracking for Outbound Leads
requirements.definition: Track leads generated by the prospective outbound campaign and transfer them into the CRM.
requirements.boundary_note: The tracking/import obligation is independent of whether the outreach itself is automated or manual.

requirements.title: Concurrent Multi-Account Outbound Operation
requirements.definition: Support at least two outreach accounts operating simultaneously, with the final account identities to be defined.
requirements.boundary_note: Concurrent account capacity is independently configurable; alias-versus-client-owned identity remains an unresolved attribute.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client asked about communication history, CRM membership visibility, profile URLs, and silent-lead follow-up, but the visible acceptance reply does not explicitly confirm each proposed solution. Retain the atoms provisionally and verify their authority during Event Extraction.

The exact lifecycle of direct Sales Navigator-to-HubSpot synchronization is uncertain: the direct path was blocked, an Apollo-mediated path was accepted, and later messages left the optional direct integration under consideration.
The forwarding request repeats argentics.io as both source and destination; context suggests the intended source may be argentics-games.io, but this should not be inferred without adjudication.

Messages initially describe Zapier as unable to create a MeetAlfred campaign, then establish a manual campaign-creation and duplicated-Zap workflow. Event extraction should distinguish the unsupported automatic creation behavior from the accepted manual workflow.

The exact final reporting implementation is not visible: custom reports were cost-prohibitive and the client accepted default reports for now, but it is unclear whether filtered CRM views were also configured.

The December outbound-campaign discussion appears to concern prospective follow-on work, and the detailed scope document is unavailable. The provisional outbound Requirements should remain low- or medium-confidence until the document or explicit engagement decision is reviewed.
